name: @sessions/platform
description: Clean-room all-in-one meetings, webinars, scheduling, collaboration, recording, and AI memory platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app,site -c auto "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:website"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @sessions/backend && dotenv -e .env -- npm run build --workspace @sessions/frontend && dotenv -e .env -- npm run build --workspace @sessions/website
scripts.lint: npm run build:contracts && npm run lint --workspace @sessions/contracts && npm run lint --workspace @sessions/backend && npm run lint --workspace @sessions/frontend && npm run lint --workspace @sessions/website
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @sessions/contracts && npm run test --workspace @sessions/backend && npm run test --workspace @sessions/frontend && npm run test --workspace @sessions/website
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @sessions/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @sessions/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @sessions/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace @sessions/website
